description: Herb up to 1 m high, stems terete, striate, ± densely hairy. Leaves broadly elliptic, 11–17 by 4–7 cm shortly acuminate with cuneate base, shortly petiolate to subsessile; lamina hairy on both sides. Inflorescences cylindrical, pedunculate, terminal and lateral, often lax towards the base. Bracts deltoid-lanceolate, 2–2.5 mm long, membranous with a pungent apex; bracteoles 3–4 mm long with an uncinate apex, base with short, membranous wings. Tepals lanceolate, acute, 3–4 mm long with hyaline margin. Stamens shorter than tepals. Pseudo-staminodes 1.5 mm long with ciliate-fimbriate apex but no fimbriate scale. Ovary obovoid; style 1.5 mm; stigma capitate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Achyranthes ancistrophora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 394. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial herb of varying appearance, usually rather stiff up to ca 1 m, occasionally much taller, often richly branched from the base; branches obscurely quadrangular, thickened above the nodes, ± densely pubescent particularly in the younger parts. Leaves elliptic-oblong or obovate, attenuate at base, acuminate to rounded at apex, more or less densely hairy to nearly glabrous, greatly varying in size, 2–10 by 1–5 cm; petiole 0.5–1.5 cm. Inflorescences of erect, terminal and lateral spikes, the terminal by far the longest, initially dense, later with remote flowers, up to 50 cm with shorter or longer peduncles; rachis angular, appressed hairy. Bracts scarious, ovate-acuminate, persistent, 2–3 mm, erect before anthesis, later reflexed as is the fruiting perianth; bracteoles appressed against the perianth, prolonged into a long spine 3–4 mm, at base with a membranous limb 1.5–2 mm. Tepals subequal, ovate-lanceolate, pointed, ca 5 mm long, glabrous. Stamens with filaments (including the cup) ca 2 mm long, glabrous; pseudo-staminodes truncate with a dorsal long-fringed scale, longer than the staminode itself. Ovary obovoid, shorter than the style, glabrous; style 2–3.5 mm. Utricle glabrous with truncate apex, 2.5–3 mm. Seed cylindrical, smooth.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Achyranthes aspera. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 395. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial, erect or ascending herb up to 2 m; branches ± quadrangular with longitudinal furrows, ± hairy with appressed, white hairs. Leaves elliptic to broadly lanceolate; base acute or obtuse, apex acuminate, both sides hairy, often reddish, 5–10(–25) by 2–8(–11) cm; petiole 1–3 cm. Inflorescences of terminal and lateral spikes up to 45 cm (including an up to 15 cm long peduncle); rachis rather thin often somewhat tortuous, covered with appressed, white hairs. Bract ovate, subulate, ca 3 mm long, after anthesis patent or reflexed; bracteoles spinose, appressed to perianth which is reflexed after anthesis, 3–5 mm long, shorter than perianth; the limb reduced to 2 membranous lobes inserted at the thickened base of the spine, or free, up to 1 mm. Tepals glabrous, lanceolate subulate, acuminate, often violet, ± unequal, 4–7 mm long. Staminal cup ca 2 mm; pseudo-staminodes truncate, without a dorsal scale. Ovary ovoid; style 1–2 mm, about same length as the stamens. Utricle glabrous, obovoid, brown, ca 2 mm long. Seeds cylindrical, smooth.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Achyranthes bidentata bidentata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 397. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial herb, sometimes woody at base, up to 1.5 m high, erect or scrambling, side-branches weak; stem terete, velutinous. Leaves spirally arranged in upper part, opposite below, lanceolate, attenuate towards a short petiole (up to 1 cm), at apex acute, mucronate; both sides with appressed, white hairs, denser on the flower side. Inflorescences solitary or fascicled, whitish to pale purplish, spikes often pyramidal, sometimes forming large open panicles but also lateral weak branches. Flowers very densely packed together, bisexual or female; bracts and bracteoles membranous, ovate, mucronate, pilose ca 1 mm long. Tepals usually 5, membranous, oblong acute, pilose ca 3 mm long. Stamens ca half as long as tepals; staminal cup low; pseudo-staminodes filiform, shorter than the filaments. Ovary ovoid, ca 1 mm; style 0.5 mm; stigma entire or somewhat 2–lobed. Utricle irregularly dehiscing, 1 mm diam. Seeds shining, reniform, reticulate, brownish-black, 0.7 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aerva sanguinolenta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 389. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Erect, prostrate or ascending annual up to 80 cm, branching from the base, glabrous or finely pubescent. Leaves linear to oblong-ovate or spathulate, narrowed to the ± winged petiole, apex acute-acuminate, mucronate or sometimes obtuse; upper surface glabrous, flower finely pubescent; 2.6 by 0.5–2.5 cm; petiole up to 1 cm. Inflorescences of ovoid to globular heads 1–2 cm long, often lengthening after anthesis; peduncle 1–35 mm. Single cymes 2–7-flowered. Bracts and bracteoles ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 2–4 mm long with green or purple midrib, margins white. Flowers bisexual. Tepals scarious, similar to the bracts but longer, 5–7 mm. Stamens shorter than perianth, staminal cup 2 mm high. Ovary ovoid, style longer than stamens. Fruit ovoid, surrounded by the persistent perianth, opening below the middle, ca 3.5 mm. Seeds lenticular, arillate, black, glossy.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Allmania nodiflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 382. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial ± erect herb 10–20 cm high, densely tufted; stems with two opposite furrows, glabrescent. Leaves rhombic to oblanceolate, glabrescent, finely mucronate at apex; usually in various degrees variegated or red, 1–5 by 0.5–1.5 cm, petiole 1–3 cm. Inflorescences of sessile, terminal and axillary, spherical or oblong heads, often few together, 0.5–1 cm diam. Bracts and bracteoles similar, shorter than tepals, acute often with a row of hairs on the back. Tepals 5, acuminate, mucronate, 3 outer ones longest, 3–4 mm, hairy on the back, 2 inner ones subglabrous, ca 2 mm long. Staminal cup low, anthers 5 but often some sterile. Pseudo-staminodes shorter than or equal to the stamens, narrow with dentate apex. Ovary ovoid, style short, stout. Fruit suborbicular (apparently not developing in SE. Asia) unwinged. Seeds (in Brazil) lenticular, brown ca 1 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alternanthera bettzickiana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 407. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial ± erect or ascending herb often with woody base, up to 1 m high; stems covered with whitish hairs. Leaves ovate or elliptic, acute or acuminate, up to 8 by 3 cm (smaller in Thai specimens?), densely villose. Inflorescences simple or branched with a 2–15 cm long, pilose peduncle; head conical or ± pherical up to 1.5 cm diam. Bracts suborbicular or ovate, shorter than the serrate bracteoles. Flowers stipitate, tepals ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 3–4 mm long, 3-nerved, carinate, hairy. Staminal cup ca 1.5 mm high, filaments as long as anthers. Pseudo-staminodas laminate with truncate-dentate apex, as long as stamens. Fruit (not seen in Thai specimens). Seeds dark brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alternanthera moquinii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 405. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial, polymorphic herb with several habitat forms (in water or on wet soil); stems up to 4 m long when prostrate, up to 30 cm when erect on dry land, simple or branched, robust, ± villous to nearly glabrous. Leaves shortly petiolate, elliptic to obovate, obtuse 3–11 cm long, glabrous. Heads always solitary, spherical, 1–1.5 cm diam., white, terminal and apparently axillary; peduncle 1–5 cm, pilose in 2 lines. Bracts and bracteoles similar ¼ the length of the flower, ovate acute or acuminate. Tepals similar, glabrous, ovate-lanceolate, ca 6 mm long, serrulate towards apex. Staminal cup low; filaments longer than anthers. Pseudo-staminodes as long as stamens with serrate apex. Ovary pyriform.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alternanthera philoxeroides. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 405. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial prostrate herb; stems often woody at base, pubescent; ± densely hairy particulary when young. Leaves ovate or obovate, 2–5 by 1–3.5 cm, shortly petiolate. Inflorescences spherical or slightly oblong, sessile often clustered. Bracts strongly spinescent, bracteoles 2, acute. Tepals unequal, 2 outer with long pungent apex, ca 5 mm long, 3 inner, shorter, acute, all with small tufts of hairs. Stamens 5, pseudo-staminodes shorter than filaments, entire or dentate. Ovary ellipsoidal; style short; stigma capitate. Fruit ovoid falling off together with perianth. Seeds lenticular, smooth, shining.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alternanthera pungens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 403. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial polymorphic herb, erect up to 1 m, ascending or creeping, rooting at the nodes, sometimes aquatic and floating, often richly branched, green or purple; stems subglabrous or with 2 opposite longitudinal lines of hairs. Leaves of varying shape often linear-lanceolate or elliptic, attenuate at both ends, glabrous or finely pubescent 1–10(–15) by 0.5–2(–3) cm; petiole short. Inflorescences axillary, sessile, ± glabrous, white, 0.5–1.5 cm diam., sometimes apparently peduncled. Rachis densely white-hairy, bracts and bracteoles ovale, acuminate, never spiny, glabrous, persistent, ca 1 mm long, shorter than the flowers. Tepals equal, ovale, attenuate, shining, glabrous or with few hairs on the dorsal side; 1-nerved or at the very base obscurely 3-nerved, 2(–3) mm long. Stamens 3, filaments with a short cup, all in all shorter than 1 mm, anthers ovoid. Pseudo-staminodes filiform, or with bifurcate apex, minute. Ovary obovoid-compressed; style very short, nearly wanting; stigma capitate to shortly-lobed. Utricle compressed, deeply emarginate, 2–3 mm long. Seeds orbicular, brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alternanthera sessilis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 406. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual herb up to 80 cm high, rarely taller, in the upper part ± patently hairy; sparsely branched, usually reddish coloured. Leaves long-petiolate, ovate, rhombic, often reddish along the margin. Inflorescences of terminal and axillary pseudo-spikes from the very base, the terminal ones often very long, 2–3 cm thick, branched in the basal part. Flower-clusters ± spherical; bracts and bracteoles longer than flowers, mucronate. Perianth 5-merous; tepals in obovoid to spathulate at least partly imbricate, in ♂ ovate-oblong, shortly mucronate, 2–2.5 mm including mucro, purple. Styles 3, ca 0.8 mm. Fruit a circumscissile capsule, slightly longer than perianth. Seeds 1–1.5 mm long, black to dark brown, reddish or even pale yellow, shining.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Amaranthus caudatus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 384. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual erect herb up to 1.5 m tall, rarely taller, often much branched; stems sparsely puberulous when young, soon becoming glabrous, longitudinally ridged or sulcate when dry, ± purple. Leaves long petiolate, petioles up to 10 cm, sparsely and minutely puberulous; lamina ovate-oblong to lanceolate, base often somewhat decurrent, apex gradually narrowed, obtuse, shortly mucronate; dark green on upper surface, ± purple on the flower; nerves often hairy on both sides. Inflorescences of axillary and terminal pseudo-spikes, erect or, at the top of the panicle, ± drooping; the whole panicle 15–40 cm long, the individual pseudo-spikes 5–15 mm diam. Flower-clusters closely congested, usually totally covering the axis. Bracts subtending the clusters 2–4 mm long, drawn out in a stiff spine half the length of the bract. Flowers usually purple, 5-merous; bracts and bracteoles long-pointed, longer than the perianth. Tepals oblong with a short mucro, ca 0.5 mm broad, in ♂ ca 2 mm long, in ♀ slightly shorter during anthesis, but later also reaching 2 mm. Stamens as long as perianth. Styles usually 3. Fruit loosely enclosed in the persistent perianth and bracts, circumscissile near the middle. Seeds dark brown, 1–1.5 mm broad, orbicular in outline.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Amaranthus hybridus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 384. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual erect herb up to 80 cm, often branched from the base, stemsquite glabrous, terete to obtuse-angled, thin. Leaves on a thin petiole, rarely exceeding 5 cm; lamina obovate-rhomboid; base cuneate, apex strongly emarginate, mucronate, 3–6 by 2–4 cm, thin, green or in variously degree blotched with purple. Inflorescences of axillary and terminal pseudo-spikes often forming a few-branched panicle. Flower-clusters separate in the flower part leaving the axis visible. Bracts and bracteoles similar, ovate acute much shorter than perianth. Tepals 3, green with scarious margins oblong in ♀, oblong spathulate in ♂, ca 1 mm. Stamens 3 as long as perianth or shorter. Ovary oblong; stigmas usually 3. Fruit an ellipsoidal, smooth, indehiscent utricle, slightly exceeding the persistent perianth. Seeds lenticular, shining, blackish-brown, ca 1 mm diam.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Amaranthus lividus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 388. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Erect herb up to 1 m high, almost totally glabrous. Leaves ovate-lanceolateto rhomboidal, attenuate at both ends, apex often emarginate, mucronate; petiole as long as lamina, 3–5 by 1.5–3 cm; at leaf-axils (1–2 spines 1–2 cm long. Inflorescences usually green; pseudo-spikes in flower part female, the ultimate cymose inflorescences subtended by weak spines, toward apex spines wanting and exclusively male flowers. Bracts as long as flowers, ovate, mucronate. Tepals in ♂ 3(–5) ovate, in ♀ 5, spathulate, 1–1.5 mm long, white with green midnerve. Stamens 5. Ovary with (2–)3 stigmas. Fruit ellipsoid, as long as the perianth, circumscissile or indehiscent. Seeds ca 0.7 mm, black, glossy, lenticular.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Amaranthus spinosus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 383. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual with erect or ascending stem, often much branched, up to 2 m tall, usually robust, glabrous or thinly pubescent in upper part; stems longitudinally ridged or sulcate when dry. Leaves with petioles up to 5 cm, but usually shorter; lamina rhomboid-ovate; base acute and most often decurrent into the petiole; apex most often acute, sometimes rounded, glabrous or nearly so on both sides in varying degree purple blotched, 3–12 by 1.5–10 cm. Inflorescences axillary and terminal; the axillary ones dense capitate clusters, the terminal ones pseudo-spikes or panieles; the heads up to 2 cm in diam. on the most robust stems. ♂ and ♀ flowers intermixed. Bracts and bracteoles long pointed from a broad, triangular base, as long as perianth or shorter. Tepals 3, green or purple with scarious margins, triangular at base, long pointed, in ♂ 4–6 mm long, in ♀ 2–3 mm during anthesis, later lengthening to 4–5 mm. Stamens 3, shorter than or as long as perianth. Ovary cylindrical or obconical; styles 3. Fruit circumscissile below the middle. Seeds shining, dark brown, lenticular, ca 1 mm diam.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Amaranthus tricolor. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 386. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual herb up to 80 cm, erect or decumbent (particularly older individuals), sparsely branched or with often long arching branches from near the base; stem thin up to 5 mm diam; glabrous or minutely pubescent when young, obtusely angular. Leaves with slender petioles up to 10 cm long, lamina ovate-oblong, sometimes rhombic; base long cuneate, apex obtuse or only slightly emarginate, shortly mucronate, very thin, glabrous, 3–6 by 1.5–3 cm. Inflorescences terminal or in the axils of the upper leaves, pseudo-spikes solitary or forming a sparsely branched panicle; whole inflorescence rarely above 10 cm long. Flower-clusters dense, usually somewhat remote, leaving the axis visible, at least in the flower part. Bracts and bracteoles similar, shorter than perianth, broadly ovate, mucronate, scarious, 0.5–1 mm. Flowers unisexual, green, usually 3-merous. Tepals green with scarious margins, oblong, acute, 1–1.5 mm long; stamens 3; stigmas 2–3. Fruit an indehiscent, strongly corrugated ellipsoidal utricle exceeding the persistent perianth and bracts, ca 2 mm long, pale yellowish-brown. Seeds lenticular, shining brownish-black, ca 1 mm diam.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Amaranthus viridis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 387. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual with finely striate stems, 50–100 cm. Ultimate leaf segments up to 10 by 0.5 mm; leaf sheaths white-margined. Rays of umbels, 10- subequal, ca 3 cm. Petals ca 0.6 mm, emarginate, incurved. Fruit ca 4 by mm with 3 distinct dorsal ridges and a ca 0.3 mm paler coloured lateral wing.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anethum graveolens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 456. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual shoots up to 6 m. Leaves cordate up to 11 by 8 cm with a short petiole. Racemes simple or little-branched up to 30 cm long including a short peduncle. Bracts narrow lanceolate, 1–2 mm. Pedicel ca 2 mm; flower pair of bracteoles broad triangular, persistent; upper pair greenish-white, broad elliptic to suborbicular, 1–2 mm. Tepals white, fragrant, obtuse, 2–3 mm long, joined at base. Stamens white. Style 1, ± deeply split into 3 club-shaped stigmas. Fruit a ± spherical utricle.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anredera cordifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 412. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual or biennial with fibrous or fusiform roots; stems fistulose, angular, striate, 15–60 cm. Ultimate leaf segments ca 2 by 2 cm, apically lobed or toothed; leaf sheaths white-margined. Umbels numerous, leaf-opposed. Rays of umbels 6–10, subequal, 1.5–2 cm. Sepals absent. Petals white, 0.7 mm. Fruit ca 1.3 by 1.2 mm, ridges narrowly winged.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Apium graveolens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 452. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herbaceous climber up to 10 m long, all parts succulent varying in colour from red to green. Leaves broad ovate with acute apex and acute to cordate base, glabrous, 3–7 by 2–4 cm; petiole 1–3 cm. Spikes up to 25 cm long, oriferous only in the upper part. Bracts minute, caducous; bracteoles similar. Perianth tube greenish, segments varying in colour from white to dark purple; whole flower 3–4 mm long. Fruit surrounded by the persistent, ?eshy, black, almost spherical, perianth. Seeds spherica 1.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Basella alba. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 410. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual, straggling herb, stems branched, up to several metres long, glabrous, 4-angular with swollen nodes. Leaves opposite, petiolate, broadly lanceolate with acute base and entire margin; sparsely hairy. Inflorescences axillary, richly flowered cymes; peduncles pubescent; bracts lanceolate, pubescent. Sepals scarious, ca 6 mm long. Petals lanceolate, apically obtuse half as long as sepals, or shorter. Staminodes 5; anthers basifixed. Ovary spherical, apically depressed; styles 2, ovules 4. Capsule 4-valved, globose. Seeds 4, warty.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Brachystemma calycinum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 419. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual or perennial flowering in first year; stems erect 30–50 cm much branched above. Leaves narrow oblong to oblong, ca 40 by 8 mm, cuneate at base, subsessile, prominently veined, apically mucronulate. Umbels numerous, mostly lateral, borne on slender peduncles up to 4 cm. Rays 3–5, subequal or unequal, ± filiform. Bracts and bracteoles ovate to ± lanceolate, thin, herbaceous to ± pellucid, prominently veined, cuspidate. Pedicels equalling flowers. Petals ca 0.6 mm. Fruit oblong, ca 2.5 by 1 mm, smooth with filiform ribs.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Bupleurum tenue. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 451. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Numerous further synonyms for wild and cultivated forms. Annual, erect, glabrous, 1-branched herb up to 1 m high. Leaves lanceolate to linear, upper ones sessile, flower ones with 1–4 cm long petiole; lamina attenuate towards base, acuminate towards apex, 5–15 by 1–5 cm. Inflorescence a white or pink spike, 1–2 cm broad, 2–10 cm long (or longer), often lengthening considerably during anthesis, dense-flowered. Bracts ovate-oblong, aristate, half the length of the tepals, persistent; bracteoles similar but smaller. Tepals 4–10 mm, ovate-linear, acuminate, scarious. Filaments joined at base to a 1.5–2 mm high staminal cup; free part of filaments longer than the cup. Pseudo-staminodes tiny, triangular. Ovary ovoid; style violet; ovules 5–9. Fruit surrounded by the perianth, ca 3 mm. Seeds few, ca 10, lenticular, black, glossy, 1.5 mm diam. In cultivated forms the upper flowers are often sterile, and branched, "tree-like” outgrowths occur, such forms are often treated as ca cristata L. or var. (subsp. or f.) cristata auct. Pl., “cocks-comb”. The inflorescences are variously coloured: red, violet, yellow or orange.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Celosia argentea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 380. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Creeping herb with ± glabrous stems to several dm in length; leaf rosettes often distant. Leaves 0.5–4.5 by 0.8–5.5 cm, 1–4(–16) per rosette, glabrous or villous below, margins crenate; petiole 0.5–25 cm, scariously winged at base, glabrous to densely villous. Bracts ca 2 mm long, ovate-elliptic, scarious, soon deciduous. Rays (1–)3–5(–9), 2–15 mm, glabrous or villous. Bracteoles ca 2, ca 1.5 mm long, broadly ovate-elliptic, scarious. Pedicels ca 3, 0–1 mm. Petals 1–1.5 mm. Fruit ca 2 by 3 mm; styles 0.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Centella asiatica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 447. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems floating or ascending, terete, striate, densely appressed pubescent, rooting at the nodes, up to 150 cm long. Leaves opposite, oblong-lanceolate, entire, base acute, apex acuminate; on both surfaces covered with long, appressed, white hairs, particularly dense on young leaves; lamina 8–15 by 2–3 cm; petiole 1–3 cm. Inflorescences of erect, many-flowered spikes up to 45 cm when fully developed; rachis densely appressed hairy. Flowers glabrous, solitary, subtended by glabrous bracts and bracteoles, first crowded, later remote. Bracts ovate, 3–4 mm soon reflexed ; bracteoles ovate-orbicular, concave, ca 3 mm diam. Tepals membranous; outermost with a narrow, transparent margin and a recurved, subulate tip, 6–8 mm long; the other four shorter and with a broader margin. Stamens much shorter than tepals; pseudo-staminodes short, cuneate, at apex dentate and with a fimbriate scale much surpassing their apex. Ovary glabrous with 1 ovule; style filiform, short, persistent; stigma capitate. Utricle ovoid, thin-walled, ca 4 mm long. Seeds reniform.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Centrostachys aquatica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 398. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrubby herb, subshrub or small shrub, 0.3–3 m tall, rarely epiphytic, iaromatic when crushed; nodes distinctly swollen, sometimes purplish. Leaves bright green, glossy above in life, oblong-lanceolate to elliptic- or ovate-oblong, 8–29 by 3–13 cm, usually long-acuminate at the apex, cuneate at the base, rather thin, the margin rather finely shallowly (rarely more coarsely) glandular-serrate, with ca 9 pairs of nerves sometimes purple beneath; petiole 0.75–1.7 cm; stipules minute, subulate. Inflorescences scented, with 5–13 spikes 2.5–5 cm long; bracts sheathing; ovate, acute. Anther-bearing organ yellow, between green and white or violet-white, 3-lobed, 1.2–1.6 mm long, median anther 2-locellate; lateral anthers 1-locellate. Ovary enclosed by the male part. Fruit white, cream or rarely tinged violet or pinkish, the tip sometimes dark violet-purple, succulent, glossy, 5–7 mm diam. Seed yellowish-white.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Chloranthus erectus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 425. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herb to ± 40 cin tall with few erect stems from a rhizome and with brous roots; stems with cataphylls about 6 by 4 mm but true leaves apparently in a terminal whorl of 4 the two nodes confluent or almost so with internode 0–5 mm long (rarely with leaves at next flower node); stems ± glabrous except for exceedingly fine emergences. Leaves elliptic, obovate-elliptic or ± round, 4–18 by 2–12.5 cm, mostly distinctly acuminate at the apex, cuneate at the base, coarsely toothed, glabrous above and beneath or with fine but often ± dense emergences on venation beneath; venation prominent beneath in older leaves; petiole obsolete or distinctly developed, up to 2.3 cm long. Inflorescences fragrant, 1–5 at the apex, ca 10 cm long with peduncle 2.5–3.5 cm long; terminal one with cataphyll-like bracts up to 3 mm long some distance above node but lateral ones with bracts often right at base of peduncles; flowers subtended by ovate undivided bracts 1.5 mm long. Male part attached round the top of the ovary, white or yellow; central lobe linear 4–6 mm long, lateral lobes similar (5–)8–9(–10) mm long; anther-cells 1 mm long. Fruit green, ellipsoid, 4 by 3 mm, ± rugose and obscurely ribbed in dry state, constricted and smoother at the base; male scar near to stigma.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small glabrous shrub, 0.5–1.5 m tall, with ascending or ± spreading branehes. Leaves oblong-ovate or ovate-elliptic to elliptic, 4–13.5 by 2–8.5 cm, rather obtuse or at least not or scarcely acuminate at the apex, cuneate at the base, rather coarsely crenate-serrate; nerves 4–6 pairs; petiole 0.4–1.2 cm; stipules membranous, linear, 2–3 mm, mucronate. Inflorescences terminal with 10–20 ascending spikes 2–5 cm long; peduncles 3–8 cm; bracts 1.5 mm; bracteoles 1 mm. Anthers 3, the central with 2-locelli and the laterals 1-locellate, the cells ± 0.5 mm long. Fruit green or yellowish, 4 by 2 mm, narrowed at the base.

description: Stems rather slender, 10–40 cm, solid, finely striate, branched above. Basal leaves soon deciduous. Stem leaves shortly petiolate, ultimate segments linear, mucronulate, basally with a white sheath on petiole. Rays of umbel 2–6, unequal, 0.5–2 cm. Bracteoles ca 3, linear, thin-textured, mucronulate, 2–3 mm. Sepals unequal, outer to ca 0.8 mm. Outermost petals 2.5–3 mm, entire or emarginate, inner ca 0.8 mm. Fruit ca 3 by 3 mm, pale brown, almost globose, ridges indistinct, undulate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Coriandrum sativum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 450. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Large tree, 20–30 m high, up to 300 cm in girth or more; bark dark grey or brownish-grey, rough, cracking and flaking longitudinally; young shoots darkish-purple; young branches quadrangular. Leaves elliptic, ovate, or ovate-oblong, 6–22 by 4–12 cm; apex acuminate; base cuneate or obtuse; glabrous and glossy green above, puberulous or glabrous, light green below; mostly chartaceous; petiole 4–9 mm long. Inflorescences 7–30 cm long with a few to several paigs of racemes along the main and secondary axes; racemes 7–20 cm long, 5–7 mm wide, yellowish-white or greenish-yellow; bracts and bracteoles narrowly triangular to linear; pedicels 1–3 mm long. Calyx-tube 2–3 mm wide, finely tawny puberulous outside, densely whitish-tomentose inside especially in male flowers; calyx-lobes 5, 0.5–1.5 mm long. Capsules numerous, globose to ovoid, 2–4 mm long, slightly laterally compressed, finely puberulous, 2-valved, faintly longitudinally grooved at the middle of each valve.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herb, rarely above 80 cm, erect or procumbent, branched; stems puberulouswith thin spreading or ascending whitish hairs. Leaves broadly elliptic to rhombic, rounded at base, obtuse to acute at apex, sparsely puberulous, 1–6 by 1–4 cm, subsessile or with a short petiole. Inflorescences of terminal and axillary pseudo-spikes up to 25 cm long, 4–8 mm broad, elongating in fruit; peduncles 2–5 cm long. Glomerules with few flowers, often 3, 1 fertile and 2 lateral sterile ones (always?) reduced to bracteoles and narrow tepals; bracts falcate ca 1 mm. Tepals scarious, lanceolate, 2–3 mm long, velutinous on the dorsal side. Staminal cup with 5 pseudo-staminodes of varying shape, obtuse, emarginate or even dentate. Ovary ovoid, 1.5 mm long; style filiform; stigma capitate. Fruit tightly enclosed within the stiff, persisting perianth parts and the up to 20 or more uncinate awns developing during maturation. Utricle ovoid, 1–2 mm long, inconspicuously operculate. Seeds flattened, ellipsoidal, ca 1 mm long, shining, brown, smooth.

description: Scandent or scrambling shrub up to 7 m high with thin, pendulous branches; young twigs pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves ovate-lanceolate, base truncate to slightly cordate or sometimes contracted towards the petiole, tapering towards apex, often long aeuminate, mucronate; when young finely pubescent, later glabrous, 4–10 by 2–5 cm; petiole 1–5 cm. Inflorescences terminal, up to 100 cm long, individual racemes with short or long peduncles, reaching a length of 5–30 cm; in the flower part of the inflorescence the racemes subtended by leaves similar to those on vegetative shoots. Rachis of racemes pubescent, bracts tiny, narrowly triangular, 1–2 mm. Pedicels 1–2 mm. Tepals 5, suborbicular-ovate, 1–2 mm, patent, later reflexed. Stamens 5, free or joined briefly at base. Ovary spherical with 3 subsessile stigmas; ovules 2–3 in each locule. Fruit red, spherical, 4–6 mm diam. with 2–5(–9) seeds. Seeds circular, black, shining, reticulate, 1 mm diam.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herb or undershrub up to 2 m high; young twigs often puberulous later glabrous. Leaves lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, attenuate towards the petiole, acuminate towards apex, 5–20 by 1.5–10 cm; petiole 1–5 cm. Inforescences axillary, densely spicate, single or paired, erect or patent. Flowers sessile, bracts ovate, 1–2 mm long; bracteoles of equal length. Tepals 5, elliptic ca 25 mm, first erect later appressed to the fruit. Stamens 5, staminal cup ca 1 mm high; free part of filaments as long or slightly longer. Ovary obovoid, stigmas 2–3 sessile, ovules numerous. Fruit white, spherical, ca 3 mm diam. with (10–)20–50 seeds. Seeds reniform, ca 1 mm diam., finely verrucose.

description: Procumbent, sparsely branched herb with adventitious roots at the nodes; stems slender, 30–50 cm long, glabrous. Leaves shortly petiolate, broadly ovate to ± circular, 1–2 cm long with obtuse base, apex acuminate, glabrous with entire margins. Stipules lobed. Inflorescences axillary; peduncle glabrous, up to 5 cm; bracts lanceolate with scarious margins, 2 mm long; pedicel short, pubescent. Sepals 3-nerved, green, with scarious margins, 2–4 mm long. Petals emarginate, up to half as long as the sepals. Stamens 5, connate at base. Ovary unilocular; styles 3, fused below, as long as the sepals. Ovules few. Capsule 3-valved. Seeds tuberculate.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tall tree, 15–35 m high; all parts glabrous; young branchlets quadrangular. Leaves oblong to ovate-oblong, 10–24 by 4–10 cm; apex acuminate; base broadly rounded to slightly cordate; lateral veins in 12–28 pairs, widely patent, prominent below, arcuate into intramarginal veins; dark green above, glaucous below; petiole stout, 3–9 mm long. Flowers nocturnal, white, showy, with an offensive smell, 4–7 cm across, in a drooping lax corymb; pedicel stout, 3–4 cm long. Calyx-tube broadly cup-shaped, 1.5–2.4 cm across; calyx-lobes 6(–7), triangular-ovate, 1.2–3 by 0.7–1.4 cm, spreading. Petals 6(–7), ca 4 by 3 cm; claw 2–4 mm long. Stamens ca 50 or more, biseriate; anthers curved, versatile. Capsule ovoid-globose, 2.7–3.4 by 3–4 cm, green turning brown, with persistent calyx-lobes.

description: Erect foetid biennial, 6–35 cm high; stem to ca 20 cm high, grooved. Basal leaves rosette-forming, 3.5–16 by 1–3.5 cm, entire, narrowly elliptic to obovate, apex obtuse, margin regularly spinose-dentate, ± sessile to shortly and broadly petiolate. Cauline leaves up to 6.5 by 1.5 cm, restricted to base of inflorescences, entire or palmately divided, prominently nerved, spiny. Inflorescences much branched. Floral leaves 2–3 cm long, obovate to rhomboid, trisect or palmatisect. Peduncles 1–5(–10) mm long. Bracts ca 5, 1–2.5 cm long, narrowly elliptic, ± entire with a few spinose teeth, apex acuminate. Capitulae 4–10 by 3–4 mm, compactly flowered, ovoid to cylindrica 1. Bracteoles ca 1.5 mm long, ± membranous. Sepals ca 0.5 mm long. Petals inconspicuous up to ca 0.8 mm, whitish. Fruit 1–1.5 mm long.

description: Aromatic perennial with a fusiform root; stems erect up to 1.5 m (or more), solid, finely striate, terete, branched, leafy. Ultimate leaf segments up to 40 by 0.5 mm. Rays of umbels 10–30, unequal, 1–4 cm. Petals obovate, deepish-yellow, ca 1 mm long, apically incurved. Fruit 3–5 by 0.5–2 mu ribs subequal.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Perennial herb, stems pubescent ascending. Leaves obovate-lanceolate, hirsute, 2–3 by 0.5–1 cm, petiole ca 0.5 cm. Inflorescences pedunculate; involucral bracts 2, leafy; spikes oblong, 2–3 by 1–1.2 cm. Bracts ovate-acuminate, glabrous, ca 3 mm long; bracteoles as long as or slightly longer than perianth, dorsal crest narrow, entire and only present in the flower part. Flowers white; tepals narrdwly lanceolate, 3 outer villous at base, 2 inner villous all over the dorsal side. Stamens shorter than or equalling perianth, anthers subsessile. Ovary obovoid; style very short, stigma bifid. Fruit obovoid. Seeds lenticular, 1 mm diam.

description: Erect or ascending annual herb up to ca 50 cm; stem angled, appressed pilose mainly in the younger parts. Leaves narrowly elliptic-oblong, attenuate at base, acute at apex with a small mucro, both upper and flower surface with appressed hairs, lamina 3–7 by 1–3 cm; petiole 5–10 mm. Inflorescences solitary and terminal, rarely paired and axillary, spherical heads, white, pink or purple, 15–25 mm diam., subtended by 2 oval, acute involucral bracts 0.5–2 cm long; flowers persistent, supported by 3 mm long bracts and surpassed by the larger bracteoles, 7–12 mm long and with a dorsal, serrulate crest. Tepals narrow, 5–8 mm, yellowish-green. Staminal tube 4–8 mm long, usually shorter than the perianth. Ovary elongated-ovoid; style distinct with bifid stigma. Fruit an oblong-ovoid utricle, 1.5–2 mm long, enclosed by the persistent bracteoles and perianth. Seeds cochleate-orbicular, flattened on the sides, 1.5–2 mm.

description: Perennial; stems erect, up to 2 m, ca 8–10 mm thick near base, fistulose or not, finely striate, leafy, ± glabrous below, often with short ± retrorse straight hairs above. Leaves 1–2 times trisect, variable in size and texture; leaflets of middle cauline leaves narrow oblong obovate to ovate-triangular, ca 5–7(–12) by 3–5 cm, ± irregularly serrate to serrate lobed; indumentum of scattered papillae-like hairs mainly on veins of abaxial surface; petioles of flower leaves up to ca 20 cm, somewhat sheathing at base. Peduncles (1–)2–18(–20) cm. Umbels mostly termina 1. Bracts present, deciduous or persisting. Rays 15–20, angled, ± densely pubescent, to 6 cm. Bracteoles several, ca 6–7 mm, deflexed, narrow linear-triangular, acuminate, shorter than pedicels. Sepals unequal, 0.5–1 mm, persistent in fruit or deciduous. Petals 1.5–3 mm, radiant (?), white or greenish-white. Fruit 8–12 by 7–8 mm, elliptic to ± obovate, apically rounded acute to obtuse-emarginate, glabrous or finely papillose; ridges distinct; vittae 1–3 per valleculae; commissural 2–several.

description: Annual, stems slender to filiform, 15–50 cm, prostrate or erect-ascending, branched, glabrous, flaccid, not rooting at the nodes. Stipules membranous, deeply lobed or fimbriate. Leaves broadly ovate to suborbicular in outline, cordate, 10–20 by 20–35 mm, with 5–7 crenate lobes, glabrous or with a few long setulose-like hairs on adaxial surface; petiole 1–5 cm. Inflorescences few, of 2–4-flowered irregular umbels borne on short ± filiform 1–6 mm peduncles. Bracts membranous, very small. Pedicels ± obsolete. Petals ca 0.3 mm. Fruit ovate, 1–1.3 by 0.8–1 mm, truncate, flat above, ± swollen below with a distinctly broad commissure, with reddish papillose-setulose hairs, ribs ± obsolete; styles reflexed ca 0.2 mm.

description: Stems prostrate, succulent, with ascending or scrambling branches, 15–40 cm, glabrous to densely tomentose. Leaves broadly ovate in outline, usually broader than long, ca 3–9 cm broad, with 5–6 crenate or serrate lobes, glabrous or with a distinct indumentum mainly on the veins on both surfaces; stipules prominent; petiole up to 17 cm with ± long spreading or retrorse hairs. Inflorescences borne in clusters in leaf axils. Peduncles 2–6 cm. Bracts at base of and amongst flowers. Umbels 15 -many-flowered. Pedicels absent to 2 mm. Petals greenish-white, ca 1 mm, lanceolate. Fruit suborbicular to oblate, 1–1.3 by 1.5–1.8 mm, dark green to reddish-brown, glabrous.

description: Stems prostrate with ascending or scrambling branches, 30–60 cm, angular, glabrous to tomentose. Leaves broadly triangular-ovate, 3.5–10 by 5–11 cm, ± clearly 5-lobed, with a prominent basal sinus almost as deep as the length of the lamina above it, crenulate or serrulate, almost glabrous or with scattered hairs on both surfaces; petiole 5–20 cm, glabrous to densely tomentose. Peduncle 7–17 cm. Bracts at base of pedicels, numerous. Umbels in globose heads, 15–20 mm in diameter, up to 50-flowered, simple. Pedicels 5–8 mm. Petals oblong, ca 1 mm, yellowish-green. Fruit suborbicular to reniform, ca 1.5 by 2.5 mm, with a ± prominent indumentum of setulose-like hairs; ribs prominent, raised; stylopodium conical with spreading styles ca 1.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Hydrocotyle siamica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 445. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems slender to filiform, 7–30 cm, prostrate or terminally ascending, glabrous or with few pilose hairs. Stipules membranous, entire or fringed. Leaves broadly ovate to suborbicular in outline, 6–20 mm broad, with 3–5 lobed or crenate lobes, glabrous or pilose, gland-dotted or not; petiole 15–60 mm. Peduncles 0.5–3 cm, filiform. Bracts at base of and amongst flowers. Umbels 3–10-flowered, condensed. Pedicels very short or obsolete. Petals greenish-white, ca 0.8 mm. Fruit suborbigular or oblate, 0.8–1 by 1 mm, brownish, glabrous or short-pilose with or without red glands, ribs distinct, raised.

description: Glabrous perennial; stems terete, solid, finely striate, to ca 50 cm, leafy, branched above, with a collar of fibrous petiolar remains at base. Leaves ovate in outline, 3–4 times pinnate, ultimate segments ca 10 by 5 mm, lobed or toothed with mucronulate apices, nervation prominent beneath; sheaths of upper cauline leaves extending the length of the petiole. Bracts present, linear, 5–7 mm. Rays ca 14, 3–4 cm ± equal, glabrous or minutely papillose-tuberculate. Bracteoles 4–5 mm, linear, scarious margined. Pedicels numerous, 4–5 mm. Sepals obsolete to 0.3 mm. Petals white 1.5–2 mm with a central oil duct, emarginate. Fruit scarcely compressed, oblong-elliptic, ca 6 by 2.5 mm, with distinct raised almost winged ridges, lateral wider; dorsal vittae 1–3 in valleculae, commissural 4; styles recurved, ca 1.5 mm.

description: Perennial or annual fragile herb; stems glabrous to spaxsely hairy. Leaves: lower subsessile upper with petiole up to 2 cm; blade lanceolate to cordate, glabrous, 2–6 cm long. Inflorescences few-flowered, lax; pedicels fragile, glandular. Sepals free, ovate 3–5 mm. Petals 1½ times as long as sepals, divided nearly to the base, white. Stamens 10(–5), as long as the petals. Ovary ovoid, unilocular; styles 5(–4). Capsule ovoid, slightly longer than calyx, opening with 5 bifid valves. Seeds brown, covered with stellately hooked papillae.

description: Erect perennial to 200 cm; stem sturdy, grooved, hollow, branched or not, sometimes somewhat scabrid above. Leaves 1–3 times pinnate, oblong to broadly triangular in outline, decreasing upwards, 5–25 by 4.5–19 cm including a ± winged petiole shorter than rachis; leaflets narrowly elliptic to broadly ovate, 8–60 by 2–35 mm, margins serrate to incised. Peduncles (0–)3–18 cm long, leaf-opposed. Bracts 0(–1). Rays 5–26, 0.5–5.5 cm long, equal or not, usually shortly scabrid, sometimes ± flattened. Bracteoles several, equalling or shorter than pedicels. Pedicels 25–45, 2–8 mm long, equal or not. Sepals ca 0.5 mm long. Petals 0.5–2 mm long. Fruit 2–2.5 mm long; styles 1–3 mm long.

description: Perennial, glabrous, with a rather sturdy vertical tap-root; stems erect, ± terete, 40–60 cm, branched in region of inflorescence. Leaves almost entirely basal, long-petiolate, once pinnate with trifid or ternate sessile segments; ultimate segments linear-elliptic to obovate-elliptic, 2.5–6 by 0.8–1 cm, entire with 1- prominent venation on abaxial surface and a distinct marginal vein, acute, apiculate; petiole 4–8(–18) cm; cauline leaves absent or few and ternate, petiolate. Umbels mostly termina 1. Bracts 3–4, linear. Rays ca 8, 5–7 cm. Bracteoles linear-acuminate, shorter than pedicels. Sepals absent. Petals yellow or greenish-yellow, ca 0.5 mm. Fruit strongly compressed, ca 10 by 5 mm, obovate-elliptic, apically rounded-obtuse, glabrous; ridges scarcely raised; vittae solitary between ridges; commissural vittae 4–6; stylopodium depressed, scarcely extending above the apex of the fruit.

description: Perennial; stems erect, branched, 40–60 (? or more) cm, solid, terete nely sulcate, purplish, glabrous or with scattered ± retrorse eglandular papillae. Basal and flower cauline leaves ternate or pinnate, long-petiolate; segments broad ovate to 5 by 5 cm, ± truncate at base, apically acute rarely obtuse, serrulate, long-petiolulate, with papillae-like hairs especially on veins on dorsal surface; petiole 10–15 cm, sheathing at base. Upper cauline leaves trilobed or entire, shortly petiolate. Umbels mostly lateral, and terminal. Bracts and bracteoles persistent with often retrorse papillae-like hairs. Rays 12–14, rather sturdy, 2–3 cm. Sepals absent. Petals ca 1 by 0.8 m, white. Fruit strongly compressed, 5.5–6.5 by 3.5–4 mm, glabrous or with scattered papillae; ridges distinct, raised; dorsal vittae solitary, commissural 4–8; stylopodium conical with reflexed styles.

description: Perennial of neat habit; tap root vertical; stems erect ± terete, 30–60cm, much branched. Leaves mostly basal and flower cauline. Basal leaves entire, long-petiolate; lamina broadly ovate to ovate-triangular, 5–13 by 3–9.5 cm, cordate to auriculate, apically acute, ± regularly finely crenate-serrate, glabrous above and below or puberulous below; petiole 1.5–20 cm; upper cauline leaves petiolate entire and serrate to ternate with deeply serrate margins. Umbels lateral and termina 1. Bracts absent. Rays 7–12, pilose to scabridulous, 2–3 cm. Bracteoles linear, shorter than pedicels. Sepals absent. Petals white, obcordate, ca 0.8 by 1 mm, glabrous or ventrally pilose. Fruit ovoid, ca 1.5 by 1.8 mm with a ± dense vesicular indumentum; ridges distinct; stylopodium conical; styles persistent, reflexed.

description: Annual with erect, branched stems 30–90 cm, almost glabrous. Leaves broad ovate in outline, thin-textured, 3-foliolate or 2 by 3-foliolate with ovate serrate glabrous leaflets, 1.5–5 by 0.3–1 cm; petioles to ca 4.5 cm somewhat sheathing at base with some scattered white hairs. Umbels several, lateral and termina 1. Bracts 0(7–1). Rays 5–12, glabrous rather slender. Bracteoles 1–3, linear, persistent or deciduous. Pedicels 2–4 mm. Sepals absent. Petals white. Fruit ovoid, somewhat dorsally compressed, ca 1.5 by 1.2 mm, with 1 or 2 fine bristle-like hairs at base, otherwise glabrous, ridges ± prominent; stylopodium small depressed.

description: Annual, erect, richly branched, pubescent herb up to 40 cm. Leaves linear, acute, mucronate, 0.5–2 cm long, 1–2 mm broad; stipules scarious, ca 5 mm long. Inflorescences terminal, more or less dense cymes with scarious bracts; peduncle pubescent; pedicel short, 2–3 mm, pubescent. Sepals free, scarious, acute, 3–8 mm long. Petals smaller, scarious, ovate or bicular obtuse to emarginate. Ovary sphaerical to obovoid. Seeds reniform.

description: Herb up to 40 cm, ascending. Leaves shortly petiolate to sessile, oblong-lanceolate, entire, 0.5–2 cm long with acute apex; pubescent to nearly glabrous. Stipules scarious. Inflorescences axillary or terminal; peduncle pubescent, 5–10 mm; bracts 2–3 long; pedicel very short. Sepals with broad, scarious margin, 1–2 mm long. Petals hyaline, shorter than the sepals, lanceolate, acute. Stamens 5, as long as petals. Ovary slightly longer than the petals. Ovules many. Seeds reticulate.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual, usually erect, more or less branched herb up to 50 cm; stems thin, glabrous, ± hairy at the nodes, green or reddish. Leaves spreading, variable in shape from lanceolate obovate to linear with a usually ± distinct petiole; lamina 1–8 by 0.5–3 cm, glabrous. Spikes terminal on the main shoot and on side branches, solitary or paired from subsessile to pedunculate, up to 5 cm; spikes first conical, later lengthening, dense, acute, up to 2.5 cm long, whitish or reddish; rachis pilose. Bracts membranous, spreading, ovate-lanceolate, acute, ca 1.5 mm long, persistent; bracteoles ovate-triangular, half as long, shed together with the perianth and fruit. Perianth much longer than bracts. Tepals lanceolate, acute, glabrous, 2–2.5 mm long. Filaments 0.5–1.5 mm, forming a low cup at base; anthers orbicular ca 1 mm. Ovary ellipsoidal; style ca 0.5 mm. Utricle ellipsoidal, compressed, pellucid. Seeds shining, blackish, ca 1 mm.

description: Annual herb up to 40 cm, often richly branched, stems velutinous. Leaves mostly all opposite, lanceolate, attenuate at base, acuminate at apex, hairy on the nerves, 2–5 by 1.2–2.5 cm; petiole 5–7 mm with stiff hairs. Inflorescences of terminal spikes, 1-few together, on a 2–5 cm long peduncle, axis 2–5 cm long, hairy to glabrous. Flowers glabrous. Bracts persistent, ovate-acuminate, 1.5 mm long; bracteoles similar but shorter, shed with the perianth. Tepals 5, lanceolate, 2–2.5 mm, glabrous, striate. Stamens 5, staminal cup 0.5 mm high with 5 triangular pseudo-staminodes. Ovary ovoid; style 0.3 mm; stigma capitate. Utricle irregularly dehiscing. Seeds ovoid-lenticular, black, dull, finely verrucose, ca 1.2 mm long.

description: Erect, branched herb, often woody at base, 50–100 cm high. Leaves ovate-lanceolate with long-acuminate apex, 4–10 by 1.5–5 cm, base rounded or tapering towards the petiole, glabrous except for few hairs along the midrib on the flower side, petiole 1–3 cm long. Racemes erect, 5–10 cm long, many-flowered. Flowers slightly scented. Bract and bracteoles minute, sometimes bracteoles absent. Pedicels patent, 2–4 mm long, reflexed after anthesis. Tepals first white or pinkish later turning green, 2–3 mm long. Anthers as long as tepals. Berry red, 3–4 mm diam. Seeds spherical, densely hairy.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Glabrous shrub or half-woody herb, 0.6–3 m tall; stems up to 1.5 cm diam. with ± swollen nodes, longitudinally ridged when dry; bark ± smooth. Leaves elliptic-oblanceolate, lanceolate or narrowly elongate-elliptic, 2–20 by 1–8 cm, Iong-acuminate, cuneate at the base, ± subcoriaceous, coarsely or shallowly very sharply serrate or dentate-serrate, the teeth with thickened points; lateral nerves in 5–10 pairs; stipules small, linear-subulate, ca 1.5 mm long; petiole 0.4–1.7 cm. Inflorescences greenish or 1 white, 3–8 cm long, the spikes rather dense, 1–3.5(–5) cm long; paired bracts 3 mm long; bracteoles oblong, 1 mm long, sometimes ± trifid. Male part with anther cells about as long as the structure itself, the non-antheriferous part much reduced. Female part bottle-shaped or subglobose 1–1.5 mm long; stigma up to 1 mm wide. Fruit at first yellow, becoming red or bright orange, very rarely black, 4–7 mm diam. (dry), shining. Seed pale, yellowish or cream.

description: Erect, clump-forming glabrous perennial, 16–100 cm high; stems terete, striate, branched above, basally with fibrous petiolar remains. Basal leaves 7–25 cm long including 2.5–15 cm petiole; blade 3–16 by 4.5–20 cm, broadly ovate in outline, multisect with ± linear, acute segments 0.4–5.5 cm by 0.5–2 mm, margins entire, somewhat thickened. Cauline leaves similar, decreasing in size, uppermost trisect or reduced to a sheath. Peduncles (1.5–)4–15 cm long. Bracts 0–1. Rays 3–7(–10), 0.8–5 cm long, ± equal. Bracteoles 6–8, ± equalling or shorter than pedicels, linear to lanceolate, unequal, free or somewhat connate at base. Pedicels 10–20, 1.5–7 mm long, unequal. Sepals minute, ± triangular. Petals 0.5–1 mm long, oil ducts usually conspicuous. Fruit 1.5–4 mm long; styles up to 1 mm, spreading or recurved.

description: Life-form incompletely known as only flowering shoots have been collected; upper part of branches glabrescent. Leaves spirally arranged, petiole 1.3–2.2 cm; lamina lanceolate-acuminate with cuneate base, glabrous except for the nerves, 4.5–18 by 1.3–22 cm. Flowers in axillary clusters. Bracts scarious, narrowly ovate, 1-nerved, ca 2 mm. Tepals 5, unequal, 2–2.5 mm, 3-nerved, glabrous. Stamens 5, staminal cup low, pseudo-staminodes absent or 5 minute. Ovary spherical; stigma 3(–2) fid. Ovule erect. Utricle ca 2 mm long, compressed-ovoid, style persistent. Seeds lenticular, exarillate, black with concentric ornamentation.

description: Erect, slender herb up to 1 m; stems with swollen nodes, sparsely hairy. Leaves sessile, lanceolate, sparsely hairy on the nerves and on the entire margins, 5–9 by 1.5–2.5 cm. Peduncle glandular; bracts lanceolate, green, 5–10 mm. Calyx glandular ca 14 mm long; calyx lobes acute. Petals white, slightly longer than calyx, blade 4-lobed, 2 lateral lobes small; coronal scales (2) present. Stamens 10, filaments as long as petals. Ovary unilocular; styles 3, ca 5 mm longer than the petals; stigma shortly decurrent. Capsule oblong-ovoid.

description: Medium-sized tree, 6–12 m high, evergreen, often sprawling, low-branching; bark pinkish-brown or grey, slightly flaky; pneumatophores stocky, 20–40 cm long, much thickened at base, gradually becoming slender and blunt above. Leaves broadly obovate to ovate, or broadly elliptic 4–11 by 3–7 cm; apex broadly rounded; base gradually cuneate to subtruncate; petioles 3–9 mm long. Flowers solitary or in groups of 2–5. Calyx ellipsoid-terete in bud, 2–3.4 by 1.2–2.2 cm; calyx-tube obconical, conspicuously ridged; calyx-lobes (5–)6–7(–8), 1.3–2 cm long, inner surfaces often reddish. Petals as many as calyx-lobes, strikingly resembling filaments 3–4 cm long, 1–2 mm wide. Peduncle usually terete. Berry 2.5–4 cm high, 3–5 cm across; cup-shaped fruiting hypanthium 1.3–2 cm long, 2.7–4 cm wide, with reflexed calyx-lobes.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sonneratia alba. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 437. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Medium-sized, erect tree, 8–20 m high, evergreen; bark light brown, smooth to irregularly shallowly fissured. Pneumatophores long and slender, 50–100 cm long, pointed, often forked at terminal ends; bases 5–8 cm diam., much thicker in old tree. Leaves elliptic, elliptic-oblong, narrowly ovate or obovate, 6–10 by 2–5 cm; apex bluntly acute to shortly mucronate or obtuse; base cuneate; midrib sometimes reddish towards petiole; petioles 2–6 mm long. Flowers mostly 1 or 2. Calyx obovoid-terete in bud, 2–2.7 by 1.2–1.7 cm, apex acute; calyx-tube shallowly cup-shaped, ridged; calyx-lobes (5–)6–7, 1.4–2.2 cm long, inner surface tinged reddish-pink. Petals as many as calyx-lobes, 1.5–2.6 cm by 1–2 mm. Filaments 2.8–4 cm long, red in the flower part, white in the upper. Peduncle often tetragonous. Berry 2.5–3.5 cm high, 4–6 cm across; flat fruiting hypanthium 4.5–6.3 cm diam. including subhorizontally spreading calyx-lobes.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sonneratia caseolaris. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 4, 1992. Pg. 439. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Large-sized, columnar tree up to 30 m high; deciduous, base usually hollowin old. Pneumatophores stout, 30–40 cm long, ± swollen to nail-shaped at the end. Leaves broadly obovate, ovate to suborbicular, 5–8 by 4–7 cm; apex broadly rounded, usually slightly broadly retuse; petiole 3–8 mm long. Flowers usually in groups of 2–5, or solitary. Calyx bud 2–3 by 2–2.5 cm; tube broadly campanulate; lobes 6–7, 1.4 ;2 cm long. Filaments 3–4 cm long. Peduncle tetragonous. Berry 2–3 cm high, 3.5–5.2 cm across; plate-shaped fruiting hypanthium 5–7 cm diam. including subhorizontally spreading to slightly reflexed calyx-lobes.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small to medium-sized, erect tree, 5–15 m high, evergreen; bark lightbrown to grey, slightly flaky; crown rounded, dense; branched from the base. Pneumatophores slender, 15–25 cm long, pointed. Leaves broadly ovate to suborbicular, 4–7 by 3–7 cm; apex broadly rounded; petiole 4–10 mm long. Flowers often in groups of 3, or solitary. Calyx bud 2–3 cm long, 1.3–1.7 cm wide, apex obtuse, finely granulate; lobes 6, 1.2–1.7 cm long. Filaments 2.5–3.6 cm long. Peduncle often tetragonous. Berry 2.5–3.5 cm high, 3.5–6 cm across, green turning yellow when ripe; flat fruiting hypanthium 2.8–4 cm wide, with appressed calyx-lobes to the berry.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Procumbent, slender herb; stems pubescent in 1 or 2 longitudinal lines. Leaves sessile-subsessile, lanceolate 1.5–6 by 1–2 cm, glabrous or hairy along margin and on veins. Inflorescences terminal or axillary, peduncles hairy like the stems; bracts linear lanceolate, 2–5 mm. Sepals lanceolate, glandular with scarious margins, 2–5 mm. Petals 5 or absent, varying in length. Stamens 5 (or 10) shorter than sepals. Capsule with 1(–3) seeds.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Procumbent herb, main branches nearly glabrous, side branches stellately hairy. Leaves sessile, lanceolate 2–3.5 by 0.3–1.2 cm, stellately hairy on both surfaces. Inflorescences terminal or axillary, peduncle stellately hairy, bracts lanceolate 3–5 mm. Sepals lanceolate, stellate with scarious margin, 4–6 mm. Petals 5, as long as sepals or nearly so. Stamens 10, as long as sepals. Capsule as long as sepals with numerous seeds.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual, aromatic, with erect much branched stems, 30–50 cm. Leaves ovate in outline, twice pinnatisect or ternate with ovate to narrow obovate ultimate toothed segments. Umbels numerous, pedunculate. Bracts 2–5, linear, acuminate, with scattered hairs. Rays 3–6, ca 1.5 cm, subequal, glabrous or with few small hairs. Bracteoles 3–8 similar to but smaller than bracts. Pedicels unequal to 4 mm. Sepals absent or very minute. Petals dorsally pilose, obcordate. Fruit ovoid-oblong, ca 2 by 1.5 mm, densely covered with short obtuse vesicular-papillose hairs.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Perennial herb up to 90 cm, richly branched from the base; stems velutinous. Leaves linear to nearly filiform, sessile, at apex mucronate, velutinous, 2–3 cm long. Inflorescences sessile or with a short peduncle, initially ovoid, later cylindrical up to 3 cm long, 5 mm broad, whitish, scabrous, softly velutinous. Flowers densely packed. Bracts and bracteoles ovate-acuminate, velutinous, shorter than the tepals. Tepals ovate-acuminate, ca 2 mm long, velutinous particular below the middle. Staminal cup low, pseudo-staminodes as long as filaments, obtuse. Ovary ovoid with an apical hardened part; stigma sessile, 3-lobed. Seeds ovoid, shining, slightly compressed, reddish-brown, 1.5 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Slender, erect herb with bluish-green, glabrous stem. Leaves sessile, narrowly triangular 2–4(–7) by 0.5–2 cm. Inflorescences terminal, lax. Calyx 6–10(–15) mm long with 5 wings. Petals 12–30 mm long, pink (-white); blade broadly ovate with irregularly toothed margin. Seeds reniform.

description: Trees with drooping branches, buttressed. Leaves simple, opposite, entire. Inflorescences of terminal, many-flowered corymbs; flowers 4–8–merous. Calyx-tube obconical or cup-shaped. Petals broadly obovate-suborbicular with short claws, wrinkled. Stamens 12–50, or more. Ovary partially fused to calyx-tube, 4–8-celled; stigma thick, lobed. Capsule loculicidally dehiscent. Seeds numerous, linear, tailed. </br></br>Three species from the south-eastern Himalayas to New Guinea; one in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Glabrous mangrove trees, not buttressed, branches drooping (S. caseolaris) or not. Roots radiating, horizontal. Pneumatophores vertical above the surface, stout, elongate, cone-shaped, sometimes forked, with soft spongy light wood. Leaves simple, opposite, entire, smooth, coriaceous. Flowers solitary or in groups of 2 to 5, terminal, 4–8–merous, nocturnal. Calyx thick, coriaceous; tube obconical or cup-shaped, persistent; lobes ovate-lanceolate or ovate-triangular, sometimes coloured inside. Petals as many as calyx lobes, very narrow, caducous, or absent. Stamens massive, up to about 300, inflexed in bud, straight in open flower, caducous; filaments coloured or not; anthers reniform. Ovary 10- or more-celled; stigma capitate. Disc saucer-shaped. Fruit a depressed-globose berry, crowned by the stylar base, resting on the persistent cup- or plate-shaped calyx. Seeds numerous, angular.</br></br>Five species, from tropical east Africa to Asia, Malesia, Ryukyu Islands, N. Australia, Micronesia, and New Caledonia; four in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
